name: SiliconANGLE

sources.title: SiliconANGLE homepage — live enterprise/emerging-tech newsroom (theCUBE); footer exposes 'Send us a News tip' modal with a Type-of-Pitch dropdown (Enterprise / Startup News / Emerging Technology), name, email, story text, file upload up to 244 MB, CAPTCHA; separate 'Contact us' modal has a guest-post inquiry option

requirements: Earned editorial — the 'Send us a News tip' modal takes name, email, pitch type (Enterprise / Startup News / Emerging Technology), story text, and an optional file (max 244 MB), plus CAPTCHA
Guest posts have a dedicated inquiry path in the Contact modal ('Inquire about guest posts')
Coverage is enterprise/emerging tech: AI, cloud, security, infra, big data, policy — consumer SaaS is off-beat
theCUBE video coverage is event/interview-driven — no self-serve booking
Sponsorship/partnership route exists ('Partner with us' modal)
preparation: An enterprise-tech story angle — funding, product with enterprise relevance, emerging tech
Pick the right pitch-type bucket in the tip form (Startup News fits a launch)
Supporting material to attach (the form accepts files up to 244 MB)
workflow: Open siliconangle.com and use footer 'Send us a News tip'
Fill the form: name, email, pitch type, story, optional file; pass the CAPTCHA
For contributed analysis, use 'Contact us' > 'Inquire about guest posts'
Coverage, if picked up, is staff-written news — no profile or listing page is created
watchFor: Enterprise remit — consumer apps and indie tools are off-beat
Tip form has CAPTCHA — human submission only
Guest columns do appear ('Guest column' bylines) but go through the inquiry path, not the tip form
SiliconANGLE 120 and awards are separate commercial products
countsAsLive: A SiliconANGLE article mentioning the company/product is published at siliconangle.com
unknowns: Guest-post acceptance criteria and whether they're paid/earned
